item.title: NOAA Releases Updated Model of Earth’s Geomagnetic Field
item.description: The High Definition Geomagnetic Model 2026 release provides enhanced resolution and reduces uncertainty in complex drilling environments.
item.dc:creator: madelyn.depodesta

item.title: Assessing the Global Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in 2025
item.description: 2025 ranked as the third-warmest year in NOAA’s 176-year record, with a global surface temperature 2.11°F (1.17°C) higher than the 20th-century baseline.
item.dc:creator: lauren.carroll

item.title: Assessing the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in 2025
item.description: Annual temperatures across the contiguous U.S. (CONUS) averaged 54.6°F in 2025, which was 2.6°F above the 20th-century average and ranked as the fourth-warmest year in the 131-year record.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: 2025 WMM Annual Report is Released
item.description: 2025 report of the World Magnetic Model has been released.
item.dc:creator: lukas.noguchi

item.title: New Jersey Seasonal Snowfall Record Discovered 30 Years Later
item.description: New seasonal snowfall record for New Jersey verified 30 years later.
item.dc:creator: lauren.carroll

item.title: New 24-Hour Precipitation Record Confirmed for Wisconsin
item.description: New 24-hour precipitation record confirmed for the state of Wisconsin.
item.dc:creator: lauren.carroll

item.title: Assessing the Global Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in November 2025
item.description: November 2025 ranked as the third-warmest November in NOAA’s 176-year record, with a global surface temperature 2.12°F (1.18°C) higher than the 20th-century baseline.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Assessing the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in November 2025
item.description: The average temperature of the contiguous U.S. in November was 46.8°F, 5.1°F above the 20th-century average, ranking as the fourth-warmest November in the 131-year record.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Key NOAA Dataset Upgraded Using AI
item.description: ERSSTv6 has been upgraded from ERSSTv5 by implementing an interpolation method using an artificial neural network.
item.dc:creator: laura.ohlmann

item.title: Assessing the U.S. Temperature and Precipitation Analysis in October 2025
item.description: The average temperature for the contiguous U.S. (CONUS) in October was 56.9°F, 2.8°F above the 20th-century average, ranking as the eighth-warmest October in the 131-year record.
item.dc:creator: lauren.carroll
